params.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
Continue exactly from the start image: a bright cafe by a window, a round marble table. The woman sits on the left (ivory chunky knit cardigan over a white t-shirt, thin gold round glasses, neat low ponytail) holding an iced americano with a straw at her lips. The man sits on the right (navy crew-neck knit, black square glasses, short two-block hair) looking down at the smartphone in his hands. The phone screen faces him and is a plain bright blank screen.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
A friend at the next table films them on a smartphone held vertically, eye level, 50mm look, two-shot. Light natural handheld sway of 2 to 4 cm, no zoom, no pan. Modern phone video: clean, natural colors, no over-sharpening, no film grain.

ACTION
0.0s to 1.5s: the woman lowers the straw a little from her lips, turns her eyes toward the man without turning her head much, and asks him in a bright, playful, upbeat tone, like she already knows the answer and is enjoying it. 
1.5s to 3.0s: the man keeps his eyes on the phone, a half-second pause, then answers with a small slow nod, his eyebrows pulling slightly together as his expression shifts from neutral to faintly confused.
3.0s to 5.0s: the woman gives a tiny closed-mouth smile and goes back to sipping her straw; the man keeps staring at the phone, his thumb twitches once on the screen, nothing else moves.

PERFORMANCE
Small expression changes, realistic stillness, deadpan sitcom timing, no exaggerated acting, no advertising smile, no look at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet cafe ambience, a faint short phone vibration buzz near the man. No music.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Both keep the same faces, hair, glasses and clothes through the whole take. She stays on the left, he stays on the right, same seating, same cafe background and window. Only one phone in frame, held by the man, its screen faces him and stays a plain bright blank screen. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

VOICE
The woman speaks Korean with a soft Vietnamese accent in a bright, light, playful tone with upbeat energy, slightly teasing, not flat, not low. The man answers low and flat, deadpan.

DIALOGUE
The woman says in Korean with a soft Vietnamese accent, bright and playful: "들어갔어?" Then the man says in Korean, low and flat: "…응." Natural conversational delivery, mouth movements match the words, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
